Quasiplanar Fusionist Dedication.name: Quasiplanar Fusionist Dedication
Quasiplanar Fusionist Dedication.description: Your fluxes can be moved. When you Sustain quasiplanar flux, including when you Sustain the spell by casting a fusion spell, you can move the flux to another 5-foot square within range. This movement happens after you Cast the Spell.

Distilled Magic.name: Distilled Magic
Distilled Magic.description: You have learned to infuse your arcane magic into concoctions that can be distributed to others. During your daily preparations, you can distill one of your spells into one of your concoctions. When you do, you Cast a Spell from one of your wizard spell slots that takes 2-actions or less to cast as part of its creation process, placing the spell inside the concoction. A creature that consumes this concoction is targeted by the spell. If you have master proficiency in spell DC, you can distill two of your spells into concoctions instead of one, but each distilled spell must be of a different rank.

Staff Striker.name: Staff Striker
Staff Striker.description: Your staff can be used as a formidable weapon with the help of magic. You gain the staff strike arcane focus cantrip.

Fickle Fate.name: Fickle Fate
Fickle Fate.description:
Cost Expend a spell slot with a spell that has the fortune or misfortune trait

You recognize that influencing fate is as simple as moving an abacus bead across a stream. You can cause the scales of fate to tip more to the center, causing the results to be more balanced. Affected creatures gain a status bonus to misfortune checks or status penalties to fortune checks equal to 2 plus half the rank of the spell.

Rebuttal r Trigger A creature within 30 feet of you would attempt to roll a check with the fortune or misfortune trait; Effect The triggering creature is affected.

Unravel 3 (manipulate) You cause an aura of balance within 15 feet of you that lasts for 1 minute. All creatures that begin their turn within the aura are affected.

Improved Familiar Attunement+.name: Improved Familiar Attunement+
Improved Familiar Attunement+.description:
You've long held that fine-tuning the magic that bonds a wizard and their familiar can improve the mystic connection and yield greater results, compared to the safe yet generic bond most wizards currently use. You've formed such a pact with your familiar, gaining more advantages from it than most wizards. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bcxIg7wi8ZAhvhOD]{Familiar} wizard feat. Your familiar gains an extra ability, and it gains an additional extra ability when you reach 6th, 12th, and 18th levels.

Your connection with your familiar alters your arcane bond class feature so that you store your magical energy in your familiar, rather than an item you own; you also gain the Drain Familiar free action instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item}. Drain Familiar can be used any time an ability would allow you to use Drain Bonded Item and functions identically, except that you draw magic from your familiar instead of an item. If your familiar dies while within 120 feet of you, it is immediately absorbed as an illustration into your spellbook, allowing you to return it to life during your next daily preparations. The familiar is always an exact duplicate of the familiar that died.

Potent Portals.name: Potent Portals
Potent Portals.description: You create a bridge between two spaces, folding timespace on itself with a portal. Choose two 5-foot squares within 30 feet to create two portals. For the purposes of movement, the squares are treated as adjacent spaces for the duration. If a creature would occupy more than one square, it must spend an additional action to angle itself through the portals before moving through. After a creature passes through space, this spell ends.

Beguiling Feint.name: Beguiling Feint
Beguiling Feint.description:
With a misleading flourish, you use mystery to set opponents. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that targets a creature within 30 feet attempt a Deception check against the Perception DC of them using your Intelligence modifier instead of your Charisma modifier.

Critical Success The enemy is not prepared to face your magic. They are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your spell and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to the creature until the end of your next turn. You can use this concealment to Hide.

Success As critical success, except the concealment ends after you take a hostile action.

Critical Failure Your magic backfires. You are off-guard until the end of your next turn.

Compressed Spell.name: Compressed Spell
Compressed Spell.description:
You reduce the area of a spell into a single, highly concentrated blast, and unleash it towards your foes. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that affects a burst, cone, or line, has no duration, and requires a save, you can alter the spell area to instead target a single creature that would be within the area of effect and the creature takes a –2 status penalty to its save against the spell. If the size of the burst, cone, or line is greater than 30 feet, 45 feet, or 60 feet respectively, it takes a –3 status penalty to its save instead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.Item.y1xvzL4H1FuW16qt]{Effect: Compressed Spell}

Studious Familiar.name: Studious Familiar
Studious Familiar.description:
Your familiar is nearly as capable of shining light on topics of knowledge as a wizard of your caliber. Your familiar is trained in Arcana and has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.j9vOSbF9kLibhSIf]{Second Opinion} familiar ability; this is permanent and doesn’t count against your usual limit of familiar abilities. Its modifier for Arcana is equal to your modifier instead of your level plus your spellcasting attribute and it does not need to prepare to Aid in order to use its reaction for second opinion when you attempt a Recall Knowledge check with Arcana and it can Aid you on your Learn a Spell activity in addition to Recall Knowledge with its second opinion familiar ability. If you gain a specific familiar that would already have the granted familiar abilities you gain from this feat, you reduce the number of familiar abilities to select the specific familiar by the same amount.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.SNZ46g3u7U6x0XJj]{Improved Familiar Attunement} thesis, you can select Studious Familiar as a 2nd-level class feat instead of a 4th-level class feat.

Mixed-Potency Tincture.name: Mixed-Potency Tincture
Mixed-Potency Tincture.description: You can combine your concoctions so that they can be consumed multiple at a time. When you prepare your concoctions for the day, you can choose to combine up to 3 elixirs or potions into a single consumable that applies the effects of each when consumed.

Stroke Chin.name: Stroke Chin
Stroke Chin.description:
Trigger You make a Recall Knowledge check.

As you lose yourself in thoughts of the arcane, you ground yourself by stroking your chin, beard, or mustache to grant yourself better insight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Recall Knowledge check and if you get a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

Planar Calling.name: Planar Calling
Planar Calling.description:
Requirements You have at least one flux active.

You call upon a creature from the flux to join the fight. You produce the effects of a summon spell appropriate for the plane of your flux heightened to a rank equal to the highest rank spell you can cast. The spell and creature must be appropriate for the plane associated with the flux (subject to GM discretion). You give the creature you summoned 2 actions for the turn when Sustain on your flux and when you use this activity. Using this activity Sustains quasiplanar flux.

Divine @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.B0FZLkoHsiRgw7gv]{Summon Lesser Servitor}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.9WGeBwIIbbUuWKq0]{Summon Undead}

Occult @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.hs7h8f4Z1ZNdUt3s]{Summon Fey}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.9WGeBwIIbbUuWKq0]{Summon Undead}

Primal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.hs7h8f4Z1ZNdUt3s]{Summon Fey}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.jSRAyd57kd4WZ4yE]{Summon Plant or Fungus}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental}

If you can cast at least 5th-rank spells, you can cast the following spells in addition to the spells listed above.

Divine @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lTDixrrNKaCvLKwX]{Summon Celestial}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kghwmH3tQjMIhdH1]{Summon Dragon}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ZbEHglw5tkJ3grQZ]{Summon Monitor}

Occult @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kghwmH3tQjMIhdH1]{Summon Dragon}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.i1TvBID5QLyXrUCa]{Summon Entity}

Primal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kghwmH3tQjMIhdH1]{Summon Dragon}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.e9UJoVYUd5kJWUpi]{Summon Giant}

Doctoral Thesis.name: Doctoral Thesis
Doctoral Thesis.description: At 11th level, you can select another thesis that you could have selected at 1st level, gaining the abilities listed for your thesis in addition to your original thesis.

Stop Passage.name: Stop Passage
Stop Passage.description:
Cost A number of charges from your staff

Requirements You are standing on solid ground and holding your prepared staff in two hands.

Your staff has become so powerful that you can use its magic to create disrupted terrain. You smash the hilt of your staff into the ground beneath your feet. Expend a number of charges from your staff up to a value no more than the highest rank spell you can cast. You disrupt the ground at your feet in a 5-foot emanation plus an additional 5 feet for each charge you expended, causing greater difficult terrain in the area. If you expended at least 5 charges, you deal force damage equal to twice the number of charges you spent with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC in the area. This force damage applies to unattended objects and structures in the area and ignores their hardness.

Copy of a Copy.name: Copy of a Copy
Copy of a Copy.description: You keep a secret clone locked away from the world in case of a dire emergency. You can spend 1 week of downtime to create a clone of yourself that does not come to life immediately as a clone normally would. Instead this clone remains dormant until more dire circumstances result. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.N6MzS5d2mtVtcyqn]{Simulacric Sanctuary} reaction.

Adaptable Energy.name: Adaptable Energy
Adaptable Energy.description:
Cost Expend a spell slot with a spell that has an energy trait and deals damage

You deconstruct the energies that would normally harm into finite energy shields which absorb such energies. You grant resistance to the damage type that matches the energy trait of the expended spell equal to twice the spell’s rank to the target or area. This exploit has the same energy trait as the resistance.

Rebuttal r Trigger You or an ally within 15 feet would take energy damage; Effect You grant the triggering creature resistance against the triggering effect.

Unravel 3 (manipulate) You grant yourself and all allies within a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] resistance that lasts for a number of rounds equal to the spell’s rank.

Become Elemental.name: Become Elemental
Become Elemental.description:
Requirements You have residual energy.

Rather than expel your residual energy outwards, you call it inwards and transform yourself utterly. You expend your residual energy to cast a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} spell on yourself, except that you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your speeds if your speed was higher, an attack modifier of +31, and a damage bonus of +14. The type of elemental you become must have the same elemental trait as the residual energy you expended.

Quasiplanar Flux.name: Quasiplanar Flux
Quasiplanar Flux.description:
You harness a fluxwave to one of the planes associated with your quasiplanar tradition, your eyes and mind exuding the power of the chosen plane. The flux appears in a single 5 foot square within 30 feet, with a semi-translucent appearance that resembles a portal to the chosen plane and lasts for the duration. As long as the flux remains open, you can cast spells from the spell list associated with the flux’s plane. These spells use the flux’s location as the point of casting and are cast using your fusion spell slots. Each time you Cast or Sustain a fusion, you automatically Sustain this spell.

Heightened (4th) You can create two fluxes to two planes of your choice.

Heightened (8th) You can create three fluxes to three planes of your choice.

Terrible Shamblers.name: Terrible Shamblers
Terrible Shamblers.description:
You have enhanced your corpses and phantasms to be more deadly and faster. Minions you created from Divest Soul automatically gain 1 action during your turn even if you don’t give them commands. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.o0QMw5sUYexhLvZi]{Divest Soul}, your undead gain the following benefits.

Corpse Its Speed increases by 5 feet, and it gains a climb Speed equal to its Speed.

Phantasm It gains a Fly speed of 15 feet, but it must end its turn on solid ground or it automatically floats down to the nearest surface at the end of its turn. If you are at least 10th level, it no longer floats down to the nearest surface at the end of its turn.

View Internal Anatomy.name: View Internal Anatomy
View Internal Anatomy.description:
Your eyes glow with strange light that allows you to see the internal anatomy of a creature you can see. You see their internal anatomy, and you gain the effects of a successful Recall Knowledge, except you can only learn information about its biology or physical characteristics, such as its weakest save or one of its resistances. If the creature is in disguise and seeing its anatomy would uncover the disguise, you learn the creature is in disguise provided it is not from illusion magic of a higher rank than this spell.

For the duration, when you successfully Aid an ally on a Strike against the creature you allow them to target vital areas, dealing 1 additional precision damage. You also deal this precision damage on your Strikes and spell attack rolls that deal damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.Item.KmB66KAlI1xcmlsA]{Spell Effect: View Internal Anatomy}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.Item.7D9CdHYBcW86QKo0]{Spell Effect: View Internal Anatomy (Aid)}

Heightened (+1) The precision damage increases by 1.

Linked Sparks.name: Linked Sparks
Linked Sparks.description:
Trigger A creature critically fails its save against the disperse action of a minion created by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.hohuWXsWCSFmvdsr]{Animated Spark}.

You have linked the release of sparks to recooperating your magic. You regain a Focus Point.

School of Medicinal Arcana.name: School of Medicinal Arcana
School of Medicinal Arcana.description:
Biology is a mystery waiting to be properly understood, and through the arcane, you believe you can unravel it. Whether you attend colleges such as the prestigious Lepidstadt University or the Venicaan College of Medicaments and Chirurgery, you use the internal anatomy of all living things to further your magic. While the arcane is not perfectly equipped to heal wounds in the way other traditions of magic are, you can still otherwise find ways to aid the body.

Curriculum

  • cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.C2DwamKrW6QHoDQg]{Deep Breath}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.iYRDFxeVpJ5KIjmr]{Needle Darts}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.f9m9DayyGy3meqUX]{Dehydrate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.J7Y7tl0bbdz7TcCc]{Enfeeble}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.zJQnkKEKbJqGB3iB]{Goblin Pox}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ElpqHitq4FqwLURV]{Cleanse Air}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]{False Vitality}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.VosLNn2M8S7JH67D]{Blindness}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.DCQHaLrYXMI37dvW]{Paralyze}
  • 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.VXUrO8TwRqBpNzdU]{Bloodspray Curse*}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.5zeSxzDxMSr0wgSF]{Sanguine Mist}
  • 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.59NR1hA2jPSgg2sW]{Blister}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.d9sBzPOXX3KT8uTu]{Grisly Growths}
  • 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.MLYTWHfewOpI3Cz7]{Field of Razors}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.6lO6uMQxbqmYho0e]{Necrotize}
  • 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.M5dp7ILSCKID9fDK]{Shock to the System*}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs]{Warp Mind}
  • 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.fBoiPXmcIO50OFFR]{Boil Blood}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.M0jQlpQYUr0pp2Sv]{Desiccate}
  • 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4WS7HrFjwNvTn8T2]{Implosion}

School Spell initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.8fv7sjrqesjr1bJK]{View Internal Anatomy}; advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.sAWHI5utUa23VUPF]{Instant Surgery}

*You know and cast this spell as an arcane spell

Mana Well.name: Mana Well
Mana Well.description: You have broken the chains of your magic to increase the amount of spells you can cast with incredible ease. During your daily preparations, choose two 1stand two 2nd-rank spell slots. You can cast 1-action and 2-action spells you prepare in those spell slots without expending the spell slot, but if you cast them without expending a spell slot you increase the number of actions required to Cast the Spell by 1.

Book Pansophism.name: Book Pansophism
Book Pansophism.description:
Whether through having read more books than most could ever imagine, arcane rituals which have put libraries worth of knowledge in your mind or simply being able to easily identify the structure and contents of a book by flipping through the pages and mapping together key words, your bibliographic knowledge is stunning.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{Hypercognition} once per hour as an arcane innate spell. Alternatively, you can target a book with the Recall Knowledge checks from your hypercognition and make only one check to Recall Knowledge. Your Recall Knowledge applies to the entire contents of the book, allowing you to consume literature at startlingly fast rates. You cannot Learn a Spell from a spell book any faster this way, but you could identify the spells within the book.

Recharging Spellgun.name: Recharging Spellgun
Recharging Spellgun.description:
Requirements You are wielding your makeshift spellgun.

The basic effects of your spellgun return at a faster rate. You regain the initial Activation of your makeshift spellgun.

Studied Backup.name: Studied Backup
Studied Backup.description: You've honed one spell as your favored spell for heightening, and you've practiced it enough that you no longer need to prepare it to cast it. Choose a spell in your spellbook that has a rank at least 3 ranks lower than the highest rank wizard spell slot you have. You can Cast this Spell without having it prepared ahead of time by expending a spell slot of a sufficient level to cast your chosen spell at the heightened rank. You can change this spell whenever you add new spells to your spellbook, or by studying your spellbook for 1 hour.

School of Dwimmeric Entertainment.name: School of Dwimmeric Entertainment
School of Dwimmeric Entertainment.description:
Throughout the world, magic and performance are interlinked, and your studies reflect that. Whether you intend on performing on stage in operatic performances yourself (as do many graduates of Taldor’s Kitharodian Academy) or you prefer to take a more managerial or backstage role (a fine aspiration for those hailing from schools like Absalom’s White Grotto), your magic will enhance any performance to new heights.

Curriculum

  • cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.yvs1zN5Pai5U4CJX]{Summon Instrument}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.pBevG6bSQOiyflev]{Befuddle}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.YgbYvkLvnWJ4WfEA]{Flashy Disappearance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.CI7F5qdwp6YngyFt]{Confetti Cloud}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.xyRjD52YZl3DBsiy]{Instant Parade}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.JHntYF0SbaWKq7wR]{Distracting Chatter}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.KAWQ5x2j4tUJ91ry]{Sparkleskin}
  • 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.a8xXWCQhIR7o6IvP]{Invisibility Curtain}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.5z1700cfG8Ybm0e6]{False Nature}
  • 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{Illusory Scene}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Hp2wmnRS6TUGZlZ2]{Rallying Banner}
  • 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.7idCEYHnPpVNL9vX]{Phantom Orchestra}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.RQjSQVZRG497cJhX]{Vibrant Pattern}
  • 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.73rToy0v5Ra9NvL6]{Duplicate Foe}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror}
  • 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wfleiawxsfhpRRwf]{Disappearance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Jvyy6oVIQsD34MHB]{Uncontrollable Dance}
  • 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HHCgEEkeeShVQf8d]{Bilocation}

School Spell initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.z0YzKrZnXUpFNI8g]{Shine Spotlight}; advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.ibaX1SgY3IudpmZJ]{Grand Finale}

Arcane Uplift.name: Arcane Uplift
Arcane Uplift.description:
Trigger You Cast a Spell from your wizard spell slots

You levitate in the air from your leftover magical energy. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. You can immediately Fly up to 10 feet in any direction after you Cast a Spell from your wizard spell slots by spending your reaction, including as part of your initial casting of the spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.Item.5ivmUrYyxQIcEhel]{Spell Effect: Arcane Uplift}

Spell Amalgamator.name: Spell Amalgamator
Spell Amalgamator.description: You weave magic of different strengths to create more powerful spells. When you choose to trade spell slots to produce a higher rank spell slot, you can choose 3 spell slots to produce a spell for a bonus spell slot of up to 3 spell ranks higher than the traded spell slots provided their combined total rank would be the same as the combined rank of two spells you could normally trade for spell blending. For instance, instead of trading two 3rd-rank spell slots to produce a 5th-rank spell slot you could trade a 1st-rank, 2nd-rank, and 3rd-rank spell slot to produce a 5th-rank spell slot instead. You must still meet all of the requirements of spell blending as normal (such as bonus spell slots each being different ranks).

Experimental Spellshaping+.name: Experimental Spellshaping+
Experimental Spellshaping+.description:
Your thesis posits that the magical practice of spellshaping can be realized more efficiently by altering variables and parameters as you cast, imitating the wizards of long ago who had to work out their own spells themselves. This allows you efficient access to various spellshape effects.

You gain one 1st-level spellshape wizard feat of your choice. Starting at 4th level, during your daily preparations, you can gain a spellshape wizard feat of your choice that has a level requirement no higher than your level, which you can use until your next daily preparations.

Linked to Undeath.name: Linked to Undeath
Linked to Undeath.description:
Trigger A minion you created with Divest Soul succeeds at an Athletics check or unarmed Strike in a non-trivial encounter.

You have linked your control of the unlife to your bonded magic. You regain a Focus Point.

Stimulated Muscle Memory.name: Stimulated Muscle Memory
Stimulated Muscle Memory.description: You can tap into the deepest nerves of your muscles to engage them past their normal limitations. You can use your Intelligence modifier instead of your Strength modifier on Athletics checks to Climb, Jump, or Swim. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks provided you Cast a Spell in the last round.

Superior Wiles.name: Superior Wiles
Superior Wiles.description:
Your wiles are even more powerful than before. The circumstance penalty increases to a –2 circumstance penalty and the circumstance bonus to spell attack rolls increases to +2.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.Item.V9kcZ4IdMFQMzXT8]{Effect: Superior Wiles}

Reporting Spell.name: Reporting Spell
Reporting Spell.description: You know how to set up your spells to be informative, even in the event that they would fail. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that would target one of your enemies with a spell attack roll or a save, you learn something about a single enemy affected by the spell. You learn one of the following from your enemy so long as it was affected by the spell: which of its weaknesses is the highest, which of its saving throws has the lowest modifier, one immunity the enemy has, or which of the enemy’s resistances is the highest. If your spell dealt damage the creature had an immunity, resistance, or weakness to, you automatically learn that weakness in addition to your choice and if your spell targeted a save with the lowest or highest modifier, you learn if it was the weakest or the highest. Regardless of the results of your spell, the enemy is temporarily immune to Reporting Spell for 1 day.

Arcane Uplift (LHT1).name: Arcane Uplift
Arcane Uplift (LHT1).description:
Trigger You Cast a Spell from your wizard spell slots

You levitate in the air from your leftover magical energy. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. You can immediately Fly up to 10 feet in any direction after you Cast a Spell from your wizard spell slots by spending your reaction, including as part of your initial casting of the spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.Item.5ivmUrYyxQIcEhel]{Spell Effect: Arcane Uplift}

Impromptu Incarnation.name: Impromptu Incarnation
Impromptu Incarnation.description:
Cost Expend a spell slot with a spell that has the summon trait

Summoning a creature is a vital tool for many a mage, but there are moments when a brief call might suffice to be more effective. Choose a creature you could have summoned with the spell you expended to use this exploit. The creature is summoned as an incarnate summon, it is up to two size categories larger than its original size, it increases its reach by 10 feet, but is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for the duration of the effect. It can use a single action immediately after you use this exploit and 2 actions before it would depart. If another creature is in the space of your summoned creature after you use this exploit, it is moved to the edge of the summoned creature’s space harmlessly. If a creature moved by this effect would come in contact with a barrier they could not occupy, the summoning fails. This is forced movement.

Rebuttal r Trigger You are critically hit by an enemy; Effect Your summon must target the triggering enemy with any hostile actions and it appears adjacent to you. It departs at the end of your next turn.

Unravel 3 (manipulate) You summon a monstrosity within 30 feet. The summoned creature gains 1 action each turn at the end of your turn and departs at the end of your third turn since you used the exploit.

School of Wandering Steps.name: School of Wandering Steps
School of Wandering Steps.description:
In days bygone, wizards were known for traveling the world on foot and showing up in the right place when needed. These wizards would travel to see the wonders of the world, spreading magic and teaching others their ways. In modern times, some still live out this lifestyle in the footsteps of figures like Old Mage Jatembe or Cobyslarni. You may have attended a formal education and left in favor of seeing the world, you may have traveled with a teacher who showed you the ways of the world, or maybe you just learned what you did by simply living your life.

Curriculum

  • cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.tXa5vOu5giBNCjdR]{Know the Way*}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{Tangle Vine}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.PGVhjDbzC4lf6aXF]{Breadcrumbs}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4c1c6eNzU1PFGkAy]{Endure}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.KcLVELhCUcKXxiKE]{Tailwind}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.UirEIHILQgip87qv]{Charitable Urge}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.IFuEzfmmWyNwVbhY]{Safe Passage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.KsWhliKfUs3IpW3c]{Wall of Thorns}
  • 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Wpgt5TYcTHLDei6J]{Grasping Earth}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.1NLMPmyCB2MBoCuR]{Tortoise and the Hare*}
  • 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.3E1p58MNQMO4GAxt]{Stagnate Time}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech}
  • 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.yrZA4k2VAqEP8xx7]{Repulsion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}
  • 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.smiVuoFMSgY2FTOO]{Dancing Fountain}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ggtZTxeyEnDYbt6f]{Momentary Recovery}
  • 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.rwCh2qTYPA44KEoK]{Dream Council}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.JAaETUBg0xlttpCH]{Summon Archmage}
  • 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.KPDHmmjJiw7PhTYF]{Resplendent Mansion}

School Spell initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.rEQnHxJ2COtkYDHi]{Magic Map}; advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.kHjT8RQ1tC3MX11t]{Perilous Road Ahead}

*You know and cast this spell as an arcane spell

Scry Spell Theft.name: Scry Spell Theft
Scry Spell Theft.description: You can now be a little more discerning when you Steal Spell. When you Steal Spell you need only specify the rank you wish to steal instead of a specific arcane spell. If you are successful, you learn of each arcane spell of the rank you chose and gain the spell of your choice.

Deliberations.name: Deliberations
Deliberations.description:
As scholars of magic, wizards take great pride in academic discourse. Though the majority of wizards argue on behalf of the arcane consensus, that the “proper” path to wizardry is deep study of spell books and channeling magic through a closely guarded arcane bond, others debate on behalf of other philosophies. Adherents to such deliberations approach the role of a wizard differently, studying their magic in alternate methods while taking on monikers such as beguilers or necromancers.

A wizard makes only one deliberation which must be chosen when they first become a member of the wizard class. This deliberation cannot be changed and represents the way in which your wizard learns and controls their magic. A deliberation replaces or modifies feats or actions that require the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.au0lwQ1nAcNQwcGh]{Arcane Bond} class feature and changes how you learn magic. You replace your training in Arcana granted from being a wizard with your deliberation skill. Your deliberation skill is used for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} activity instead of Arcana when you attempt to learn new wizard spells and you use your Intelligence modifier instead of the normal modifier for your skill checks when you do. Your deliberation typically also alters how you learn spells and how others can learn spells from you. If a wizard feat, class feature, or spell would use Arcana, you use your deliberation skill instead of Arcana for the purposes of checks and determining effects based on your rank in Arcana.

Your deliberation replaces your arcane bond with another aspect of magic that closely tethers you to the arcane. You replace the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item} free action with a new action associated with your deliberation.

Superior Theft Retention.name: Superior Theft Retention
Superior Theft Retention.description: Your thieving of spells now allows the magic to linger. When you Steal Spell, you retain the ability to Cast the Spell for up to 1 minute instead of until the end of your next turn.

Glyph-Triggered Spell.name: Glyph-Triggered Spell
Glyph-Triggered Spell.description:
You can carve out an arcane glyph to imbue it with your magic, causing it to trigger under the right circumstances. You can spend 1 minute drawing an arcane glyph on the surface of a nearby square and then you Cast a Spell that takes 2-actions or less to cast. The spell you cast must be a cantrip or at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have. The spell you cast does not take effect and is instead contained within the glyph, triggering when a creature you specify enters the area of the glyph. You must make all decisions regarding the spell at the time you cast it, including the area, who the spell will target, and any other criteria for determining the spell. If the spell targets an area of effect, it must include the square you selected in its area, and if the spell targets a creature, the creature must be within 5 feet of the glyph, both of which are determined at the time of casting.

Once the trigger is met, the spell is cast immediately. The glyph lasts until the spell is cast, the glyph is disrupted with an Interact action, or 1 hour has passed, whichever comes first. A creature can notice the glyph spell with a successful Perception check against your spell DC.

Babbling Profusion.name: Babbling Profusion
Babbling Profusion.description:
Cost Expend a spell slot with a spell with the linguistic trait

You muddle language into gurgling, morphed sounds, and render all forms of communication utterly ineffective.

Rebuttal r Trigger A creature within range would use an action with the linguistic trait; Effect You attempt to counteract the triggering action.

Unravel 3 (manipulate) You create an emanation of babbling, morphing all speech in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] for a number of rounds equal to the rank of the spell you expended. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11] to use actions with the linguistic trait while within the area and text within the area is muddled to be illegible. You can choose to ignore a number of creatures or objects of text from this effect equal to the rank of the expended spell. This does not affect the Cast a Spell activity unless the spell being cast has the linguistic trait.

Verbose Hypothesis.name: Verbose Hypothesis
Verbose Hypothesis.description:
You have accrued enough truly obscure arcane knowledge that you can easily throw yourself into passionate, jargon-filled arguments. Choose a creature within 30 feet to make a verbose argument against, challenging your intellectual equals, and numbing the minds of those who do not understand. Make an Arcana roll against the Will DC of your target. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Critical Success You thoroughly overwhelm the target. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}. If the creature has an intelligence modifier lower than yours, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you and remains stupefied 2 so long as it is fascinated. Otherwise, it is stupefied 2 until it spends two actions with the concentrate trait arguing against your statement. These actions need not be consecutive.

Success As a critical success, but the creature is stupefied 1.

Critical Failure Your target calmly retorts either with unphased candor or dismissive condescension, destroying your argument and your ego. You are stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Multi-Tasking Substitution.name: Multi-Tasking Substitution
Multi-Tasking Substitution.description: You are able to swap a handful of spells at the same time. When you spend 10 minutes to empty one of your prepared spell slots and prepare a different spell from your spell book, you can instead empty a number of prepared spell slots equal to 1 plus half your level and prepare a different spell from your spellbook in each of these slots.

Powerful Sparks.name: Powerful Sparks
Powerful Sparks.description: Your objects become more formidable under your control. Your minions from animated spark lose their weakness and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Le8UWr5BU8rV3iBf]{Tough} pet ability. In addition, they increase their existing Speeds by 10 feet.

Spellsplitter.name: Spellsplitter
Spellsplitter.description: Magic can be rewritten in moments thanks to your thoroughly written notes. When you prepare your spells during your daily preparations, you can also choose to split into lower level spell slots. You can trade one spell slot for two bonus spell slots of at least 2 spell ranks lower than the traded spell slot. You can exchange as many spell slots as you have available, but you cannot split a spell slot you have already split. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.OqyS9UAu0l4OBBB9]{Split Spell} activity.

School of Planar Jurisprudence.name: School of Planar Jurisprudence
School of Planar Jurisprudence.description:
Throughout the universe and the planes beyond it, there are those who seek order through sovereign authority. From aeons who wrote the fundamental rules of reality, to psychopomps that judge the dead, to archons who fight for justice and devils who punish the sinful, practitioners of law are found everywhere. The greatest politicians, legislators, and attorneys study at schools such as Egorian Academy of the Magical Arts or Almas University, and focus their studies on perfecting the law as proposed by those planes concerned with it. From diabolist lawyers to akashic bureaucrats, these wizards govern the universe through law.

Curriculum

  • cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.EqdSKqr8Qj5TUhMR]{Approximate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.BvNbDwFYaidKJG9j]{Time Sense}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.2tHYKoVc5YhSewDO]{Leaden Steps}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TjWHgXqPv5jywMti]{Pocket Library}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.q5qmNn144ZJGxnvJ]{Befitting Attire}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.B3eLlbaPxOYHcs1o]{Curse of Lost Time}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.rfFZKfeCSweFv7P3]{Impending Doom}
  • 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.D6BcAoWFxHYTKwVZ]{Morass of Ages}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HqTI6wRrck1YXp3F]{Telepathy}
  • 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.R9xqCBblkS5KE4y7]{Sending}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ba12fO37w7O37gim]{Summon Axiom*}
  • 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}
  • 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HES5jvGiNZZnJycK]{Lifewood Cage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.AlbpWWN87yGegoAF]{True Target}
  • 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.y2cQYLr5mljDSu1G]{Unrelenting Observation}
  • 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ZqmP9gijBmK7y8Xy]{Weapon of Judgment*}

School Spell initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.wqFMsuigkgN7yQN0]{Summon Jury}; advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.gwG0MQ46uSaLTqCc]{Hand of Judgement}

Slot Rehearsed Reload.name: Slot Rehearsed Reload
Slot Rehearsed Reload.description:
Requirements You are wielding your makeshift spellgun.

You unleash magic and promptly load your weapon. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from one of your wizard spell slots, you can Interact to reload the firearm of your makeshift spellgun as part of casting the spell.

Basic Offense.name: Basic Offense
Basic Offense.description: You have a specific cantrip that is more potent than others. During your daily preparations, choose a cantrip of the arcane tradition that deals damage, has no duration, and takes 2- actions to cast. You can choose to cast the spell as a single action by halving the damage the spell would deal and giving it the flourish trait. Alternatively, you can increase the number of actions to Cast the Spell to 3-actions to increase the damage dealt by 2 per rank. The spell otherwise functions as the original spell. You cannot use a spellshape on a spell you modify in this way.

Quick Substitution.name: Quick Substitution
Quick Substitution.description: You can make substitutions on the fly. Choose a prepared spellslot and prepare another spell in the chosen slot that you could have prepared during your daily preparations.

Big Shot.name: Big Shot
Big Shot.description:
Requirements You are wielding your makeshift spellgun and it has at least one activation left.

You fire a devastating shot from your spell gun. You Cast a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast and requires a spell attack roll. The effects of the spell don't occur immediately but are imbued into the next Activation of your makeshift spellgun. Your spell is coupled with the spell attack roll from your spellgun’s Activation, using your spell attack roll result to determine the effects of both the Activation and the spell. This counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty, but you don't apply the penalty until after you use this activity. This activity otherwise has the same limitations as a magus’ Spellstrike.

Elemental Study Notes.name: Elemental Study Notes
Elemental Study Notes.description: You are especially well learned on elementals and the elemental planes. When you attempt to Learn a Spell with an elemental trait and you roll a critical failure you get a failure instead and when you roll a failure, you can attempt to try again before gaining another level. In addition, when you Recall Knowledge on a creature or plane with an elemental trait or attempt to Research such things, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check.

Extradimensional Pockets.name: Extradimensional Pockets
Extradimensional Pockets.description: You have found that having small pocket dimensions can be useful, both for subterfuge and for the purposes of retrieving things you need quickly. During your daily preparations, you select one article of clothing to gain an extradimensional space which can hold up to half your level in Bulk that lasts until you select a new article of clothing. Any item stored in this extradimensional space must be 1 Bulk or less. This extradimensional space is hard to notice, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object} within it and you can use Arcana to Conceal an Item in this extradimensional space. While you are wearing the clothing imbued with your extradimensional space, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.io2C4gxyi82BxjfZ]{Flick of the Wrist} activity.

Constructed Spark.name: Constructed Spark
Constructed Spark.description: You can call upon an amalgamation of objects to fight for you. If your next action is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.hohuWXsWCSFmvdsr]{Animated Spark}, you gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lKcsmeOrgHtK4xQa]{Summon Construct} spell of the highest rank spell you can cast instead of the normal effects of the spell.

Caged Specimens.name: Caged Specimens
Caged Specimens.description:
You keep a magical creature in an ornate cage, glass bottle or other container in order to better understand its magical abilities. After defeating, purchasing or otherwise coming across a Small or smaller magical creature, you can lock them away and take notes on their abilities. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} using Arcana instead of the normal skill and you learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.s7ILzY2xh1tc9U1v]{Tame} cantrip as an arcane cantrip.

You can study a creature that can Cast a Spell that appears on the arcane tradition, allowing you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} the creature can cast if your check also exceeds their Will DC. This usually requires that the creature be kept in captivity, but some creatures may allow you to study them of their own free will, allowing you to ignore the need to exceed their Will DC (subject to GM discretion).

Divergent Study.name: Divergent Study
Divergent Study.description: At 1st level you choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.OAcxS625AXSGrQIC]{Spell Blending} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.QzWXMCSGNfvvpYgF]{Spell Substitution} for your divergent study. You gain the effects of your choice.

Arcane Legerdemain.name: Arcane Legerdemain
Arcane Legerdemain.description: You can take things from others with the blink of an eye and some quick gestures. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jDdOqFmZLwE4dblQ]{Pickpocket} skill feat. You can use your Intelligence modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object} and these actions gain the arcane trait if you do.

Dangerous Fluxes.name: Dangerous Fluxes
Dangerous Fluxes.description:
You can cause your quasiplanar fluxes to take shape physically, causing planar energy to seep through. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.7exSZrsaySDHtobU]{Quasiplanar Flux}, you can increase the casting time to a single action to create a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] from your flux. Creatures that begin their turn within the area of the flux take damage equal to twice the rank of the spell with a @Check[fortitude|against:spell|basic] save. The type of damage is determined by the plane you chose and the bursts last as long as the spell is active.

  • Astral @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[mental]]

  • Boneyard @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[spirit]]

  • Creation's Forge @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[vitality]]

  • First World @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[mental]]

  • Plane of Air @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[electricity]]

  • Plane of Earth @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[bludgeoning]]

  • Plane of Fire @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[fire]]

  • Plane of Metal @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[slashing]]

  • Plane of Water @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[cold]]

  • Plane of Wood @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[piercing]]

  • The Celestial Planes @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[spirit]|traits:holy] with the holy trait

  • The Fiendish Planes @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[spirit]|traits:unholy] with the unholy trait

  • The Netherworld @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[void]]

  • The Void @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level/2)))[void]]

Unfailable Guise.name: Unfailable Guise
Unfailable Guise.description: You apply your cipher’s magic so that you can control your own appearance, creating an alternate identity that you can assume when matters call for it. You can use Arcana instead of Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate}, allowing you to use Impersonate without a disguise kit and giving it the arcane trait. During your daily preparations you can choose a single identity to Impersonate, and you can assume this identity by spending a single action to Impersonate instead of the normal amount of time and your impersonate gains the arcane trait and loses the exploration trait. This identity cannot be of a specific creature. You can Dismiss disguises you created using the arcane trait.

Linked Pilfering.name: Linked Pilfering
Linked Pilfering.description:
Trigger You suceeded your Steal Spell against an unwilling target and gained a spell.

You pilfer a pinch extra when you thieve spells. You regain a Focus Point.

Darkness Form.name: Darkness Form
Darkness Form.description:
You allow elemental shadow to merge with your body, becoming a living shadow. You transform into a Medium battle form that resembles yourself as an elongated shadow, traveling over floors and walls as your own shadow might. While in this form, you gain the incorporeal trait and you can take the Hide action even while being observed in dim light or darkness. You can Dismiss the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities:

  • AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

  • 10 temporary Hit Points.

  • Darkvision

  • Resistance to all damage equal to half the spell’s rank

  • A shadowy hand unarmed melee strike, which is the only attack you can Strike with. Your attack modifier is +16, and you deal 2d6 void damage with shadowy hand Strikes. These attacks are Dexterity-based (for the purpose of the clumsy condition, for example). If your attack modifier for Dexterity-based unarmed attacks is higher, you can use it instead.

  • Acrobatics and Stealth modifier of +16, unless your own is higher.

Heightened (5th) You instead gain AC = 19 + your level, 15 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +18, a damage bonus of +5, double the damage dice, Acrobatics +21, and Stealth +21.

Heightened (7th) Your battle form can be up to Large in size and your attacks have 10-foot reach if you are at least Large. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 20 temporary HP, resistance to all damage equal to the spell’s rank, an attack modifier of +24, a damage bonus of +15, double the damage dice, Acrobatics +25, and Stealth +25.

Heightened (9th) Your battle form can be up to Huge in size and your attacks have 10-foot reach if you are at least Large, and 15-foot reach if you are Huge.You instead gain AC = 24 + your level, 30 temporary HP, resistance to all damage equal to the spell’s rank, an attack modifier of +29, a damage bonus of +25, triple the damage dice, Acrobatics +29, and Stealth +29.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.XTS9fbMIZvxSeDw2]{Spell Effect: Darkness Form}

Consume Item Magic.name: Consume Item Magic
Consume Item Magic.description:
Requirements You are holding a magical item with the consumable trait.

You absorb the magic within an object in order to restore your magic. You consume the required item and regain a spell slot for a spell you previously cast during the day of a rank equal to or less than half the required item’s level. The spell slot you regain must share at least one trait with the required consumable.

Advanced Elective Spell.name: Advanced Elective Spell
Advanced Elective Spell.description: You develop your elective studies to even greater heights. You gain the advanced school spell from the school you selected for Elective School Spell.

Cosmic Glow.name: Cosmic Glow
Cosmic Glow.description:
You call the cosmos to create four miniature stars that shimmer with cosmic light in a space within the range. The cosmic glow sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius (and dim light to the next 10 feet). The cosmic glow deals 2d4 fire damage to each creature in the square in which it appears, with a basic Reflex save, and creatures that critically fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the cosmic glow. The first time you Sustain this spell each turn, you blink your cosmic glow to a square within 15 feet and in range of the spell. It then deals damage to each creature who shares its space. If your cosmic glow occupies your space or the space of one of your allies, you can choose for the glow to not deal damage but instead grant a +2 status bonus to Recall Knowledge checks for as long as it remains in the creature’s space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

I Walk, You Follow.name: I Walk, You Follow
I Walk, You Follow.description: Your creations remain under your control as needed. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.o0QMw5sUYexhLvZi]{Divest Soul}, except the creature remains in your service for 1 day instead of 1 minute. If you use I Walk, You Follow again, any previous effects from I Walk, You Follow immediately end and the undead becomes a corpse again. You can continue to use this effect on subsequent days on an existing minion, preserving the corpse and keeping it under your command.

Worldcrafter.name: Worldcrafter
Worldcrafter.description: Like a little god, you have mastered the art of creating worldspheres, a type of miniature demiplane contained in a palm-sized floating sphere. These worlds have their own ecosystems, magic properties and life forms of your own design; the 24 hours that they last represent the dawn of their planet’s creation to the end of time to those within. Though you may have multiple that you are crafting or have in your collection, you can only select one worldsphere to be your active worldsphere, which you do during your daily preparations. You must select all the characteristics of your worldsphere when you prepare it. You gain the Deploy Worldsphere activity.

Research Partner.name: Research Partner
Research Partner.description: You can have your familiar take on tasks that would normally require yourself, gaining the fruits of its labors when you return. You can leave your familiar in a location to perform learned activities on your behalf. Your familiar can use the following activities, so long as it has the skilled familiar ability in an appropriate skill: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OizxuPb44g3eHPFh]{Borrow an Arcane Spell}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{Research}. Your familiar performs these activities on your behalf, using its modifiers instead of your own and you need not be present for these activities for it to do so, allowing you to perform other activities while your familiar does so. You must still provide any costs associated with the activities and you gain the benefits of the activities instead of your familiar the next time you are in the presence of your familiar.

Potion Synthesis.name: Potion Synthesis
Potion Synthesis.description: You have developed techniques to alter chemistry on the fly. You can spend 10 minutes to reprepare one of your concoctions into another concoction you could have created as part of your daily preparations.

Wizardly Regalia.name: Wizardly Regalia
Wizardly Regalia.description: The iconic wear of a good wizard often includes a pointed hat, a cloak and a staff, but sometimes taking more contemporary fashion such as vests and silk shirts, pouches full of scrolls and ornate glasses. Regardless of the form it takes, it inspires a confidence in strangers of your wizardly acumen and scholarly views. You can Craft accessory runes and can use Arcana instead of Crafting to Craft when you do. While wearing clothing which identifies you as a wizard, you can use Arcana instead to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} instead of the normal skill, provided you could influence the target through a show of magic or with your knowledge of the arcane.

Impossible Library.name: Impossible Library
Impossible Library.description:
Your knowledge of magic is near-omniscient, and after countless nights of study, you have cracked the code that allows you to learn spells in a single moment. You add up to 10 new spells to your spellbook for each rank of spell you can cast below 10th using an expanded library linked from your mind which you gain when you select this feat. If you later retrain this feat, you lose all spells you learned from your expanded library.

In addition, you only take 3-actions to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} regardless of the rank and when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.MjQyTcV8Jiv1Jtln]{Recognize an Arcane Spell}, you can add the spell to your spellbook so long as you attempt to Learn the Spell within 1 day of when the spell was cast without needing a written copy of the spell or someone to teach you.

Force Disruption.name: Force Disruption
Force Disruption.description:
Cost Expend a spell slot of a force spell or a spell that provides an AC bonus

By crossing together spell slots in ways that should not work, you inelegantly unleash eruptions of pure, unrestrained force magic. Your exploit deals @Damage[1d6[force]] damage per rank of the spell you expended with a @Check[reflex|against:spell|basic] save and creatures that fail their save against the effect are moved 5 feet away from the center of the area of effect or 10 feet if it was a critical failure. Creature’s that come in contact with objects during this movement are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of their turn.

Rebuttal r Trigger An enemy moves within 5 feet of you; Effect You exert a force disruption in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. If this reaction occurs during the movement of a creature, it can continue its movement with the same action that triggered the move after your reaction provided it could still have moved.

Unravel 3 (manipulate) You exert force disruptions in three non-overlapping @Template[type:burst|distance:5] within 30 feet.

Scholar's Lore.name: Scholar's Lore
Scholar's Lore.description:
You are well versed in the academic teachings of your school. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat twice but you must select two Lores that would be appropriate for your Arcane School—for example, a wizard of the school of Battle Magic may give you Siege Lore and Warfare Lore, while a wizard of the school of Aetheric Astrologia may give you Aeon Lore and Astrology Lore. In addition, the first time you successfully identify a creature during an encounter using Recall Knowledge with your scholar’s Lore skills, the creature has a –1 status penalty to its saves and AC against the next spell you cast that encounter.

Special If you are a wizard of the School of Unified Magical Theory, you can select any Lore skill for your choice for Additional Lore.

Swirled Spine Staff.name: Swirled Spine Staff
Swirled Spine Staff.description: You combine two staves by interweaving them into a single staff. When you Craft your makeshift staff into another type of magical staff, you can choose to combine two magical staffs into the same staff. Choose two magical staves you could Craft. One of the staves must have an item level at least 5 levels lower than your level. You can Craft both staves into your makeshift staff, using the cost of both staves combined for the purposes of determining its cost. Your combined staff functions as a single staff with an item level equal to the highest level staff you combined and it has access to the spells and abilities of both staves.

School of Aethereal Astrologia.name: School of Aethereal Astrologia
School of Aethereal Astrologia.description:
Your magic is inspired by the stars above; how they interact with one another, what their geometry with Golarion means at any given time, and the things that lurk between the stars. You may be an attendant of schools like The College of Dimensional Studies in Katapesh with its incredible astrolabes, or The University of Korvosa in Varisia with its mathematical focus on the stars. Wherever you hail from, celestial bodies are both guides and tools to your spellcraft.

Curriculum

  • cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.sX2g6WFSQPNW9jzx]{Warp Step}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.EUMjrJJwSgsqNidi]{Anticipate Peril}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.F1fQC9SarAkjNxpP]{Gravitational Pull}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ynm8JIU3sc3qUMpa]{Everlight}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.L10q1ng6U3sega9S]{Guiding Star*}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.06pzGkKTyPE3tHR8]{Gravity Well}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HWrNMQENi9WSGbnF]{Wall of Radiance}
  • 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Hb8GdAhP0zBCv3zU]{Chromatic Ray}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.DcmWrD0V5PWQQyDm]{Variable Gravity}

  • 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ZMvplR106Jxl7B15]{Awaken Entropy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.P1iqzEIidRagUs7W]{Zero Gravity}
  • 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.IHUs4qn27RrdFQ5Y]{Cosmic Form*}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kk7JKox6MdGAWmCH]{Vacuum}
  • 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vm9O7ne48NM72yrJ]{Falling Sky}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.y2cQYLr5mljDSu1G]{Unrelenting Observation}
  • 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.jrBa9deU2ULFWvSl]{Falling Stars}

School Spell initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.T6c88r5rJTMebu6G]{Cosmic Glow}; advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.b2bHRCwvXxD1Dc5n]{Form Constellation}

Form Constellation.name: Form Constellation
Form Constellation.description:
An ethereal link forms between yourself and your allies, giving you a glowing starlight that mirrors a constellation in the stars. Choose between the Cosmic Caravan and Dragon Empires zodiac when you first learn this spell; you cannot select both types.

When you Cast the Spell you choose a constellation from the table for your zodiac. Draw five lines, one at a time; each line must anchor at you or a creature or object already connected to a previous line, and it must end at a creature or object within 15 feet of its anchor (possibly allowing the asterism to extend to its full 75-foot range). Once placed, the lines do not move.

You and allied creatures that begin their turn in spaces along these lines or anchor points gain the effects of the spell until the end of their turn. The lines shed light like a torch.

Heightened (8th) The status bonuses increase by 1 or by 10 if the status bonus was to Speeds.

Sure Wand.name: Sure Wand
Sure Wand.description:
Trigger You are holding your makeshift wand.

You are sure with your wand, in all senses. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}, except the effect only applies to spell attack rolls you make while holding your makeshift wand.

Consult Tome.name: Consult Tome
Consult Tome.description:
Requirements You are holding your spellbook.

The spellbook is a powerful tool with invaluable notes locked within, and when you set your mind to scouring its pages for a trusted spell you are able to replicate it without preparation. During your daily preparations, select a number of spells equal to half your Intelligence modifier to be selectable as your Consulted Spells. If you are at least 10th level, you can select a number of spells equal to your Intelligence modifier instead.

When you enter this stance, you choose a creature, haunt, or object as your target and one of your Consulted Spells. The spell becomes your Consulted Spell. You can expend a separate prepared spell slot of any rank you have to cast your Consulted Spell, heightening to the expended spell’s rank, but you must include the target in your spell’s effects when you Cast the Spell. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn when you Cast a Spell in this way as you glance back at your notes frequently.

Shaped Spell.name: Shaped Spell
Shaped Spell.description: You can shape spells in advance. During your daily preparations, choose a number of prepared spells up to your Intelligence modifier that require 2-actions or less to cast to be shaped spells. You these spells gain the effects of a 1-action spellshape you know, allowing you to Cast the Spell for its normal action cost. You can choose different spellshapes for each of your shaped spells, and the spells gain the traits of the spellshape in addition to its own. You must still provide any costs, frequency, or requirements of the spellshape on casting the spell. You cannot use a spellshape on a shaped spell.

Swift Exploits.name: Swift Exploits
Swift Exploits.description: You are extremely quick with your exploits. You gain an additional reaction each turn which you can only use for exploits. In addition, when you use the 3-action version of an exploit, you can Stride up to half your speed before you use the exploit.

Deep Magick.name: Deep Magick
Deep Magick.description:
You have uncovered ancient spells that few have seen in millennia, and applied their methods to new spells. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} activity to create variants of spells you know, allowing you to change them in subtle ways to produce new effects. The spells must be cast from spell slots and of the arcane tradition and at least 2 ranks lower than the highest rank spell you can cast. Choose one of the following effects appropriate for the spell when you Learn the Spell:

  • Area Concealment You modify a spell that deals damage in an area to leave behind lingering concealment in the area for 1 round of a type appropriate for the spell (such as smoke for a fire spell or stormy clouds for an electricity spell). If the spell was at least 7th-rank, the duration is 2 rounds.

  • Propulsive Ray You modify a spell that would require a spell attack roll to also propel the target away from you on a success, moving the target 5 feet from you on a success or 10 feet on a critical success. If the spell was at least 7thrank, the distance pushed is double the normal amount.

  • Muddled Targets You modify a spell that would target a single creature to target all creatures in a 5-foot burst with the same range as the original spell but the DC of the spell is reduced by 2. If the spell was at least 7th-rank, the DC of the spell is instead reduced by 1.

  • Wall Construct You modify a wall spell to become a towering creature made of the same substance as the wall. The spell gains the summon trait and the creature uses the statistics for another creature that could have been summoned with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lKcsmeOrgHtK4xQa]{Summon Construct} spell of the same rank. If the wall spell dealt damage, such as wall of fire, the construct’s Strikes deal the same damage type.

Staff Striker (TAPj).name: Staff Striker
Staff Striker (TAPj).description: Your staff can be used as a formidable weapon with the help of magic. You gain the staff strike arcane focus cantrip.

Arise, My Minion!.name: Arise, My Minion!
Arise, My Minion!.description:
Trigger You reduce a living creature within 30 feet of your level or lower to 0 Hit Points with lethal damage.

You bring others to be servants in death with the snap of your fingers. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.o0QMw5sUYexhLvZi]{Divest Soul} on the triggering creature, producing a corpse or phantasm minion in your service, and it gains its actions immediately.

Eldritch Ballistics.name: Eldritch Ballistics
Eldritch Ballistics.description:
You have spent hours studying imported firearms from around the planet and produced blueprints for your own unique spellguns, arguing that once perfected, these weapons will be the implement of choice for spellcasters everywhere. You start play with a makeshift spellgun designed by you made from a firearm of your choice.

Only you know how to Activate your spellgun and unlike other spellguns it is not destroyed once used, instead becoming a regular firearm of its type until your next daily preparations. You can also use your spellgun as a firearm of its type and using your spellgun’s Activation does not discharge the weapon. Your makeshift spellgun always has the following Activation.

In addition, you can use the Craft activity to create spellguns. You can learn the formulas for spellguns using your spellbook as your formula book and you automatically add the formula for your unique spellgun to your list of formulas. At 4th level and every 2 levels beyond that, you gain the formula for a common or uncommon spellgun of that level or lower (a 4th-level spellgun if you’re 4th level, a 6th-level spellgun if you’re 6th level, and so on).

If you are at least 5th level, you can create one temporary spellgun using a formula you know during your daily preparations. You can create an additional temporary spellgun for every 5 levels you possess beyond 5th level, up to a maximum of 4 temporary spellguns at 20th level.

You can combine or separate spellguns from your makeshift spellgun in a process that takes 10 minutes, granting your spellgun an additional Activation of the spellgun you combined. You can use each of the Activations of your makeshift spellgun before it becomes a normal firearm of its type. When you use the Activation of a combined spellgun, your spellgun loses that Activation as if it were consumed.

Grimoire Study.name: Grimoire Study
Grimoire Study.description: You know how to uncover spell variants in an instant. You can spend 10 minutes to empty one of your prepared spells that has a Spell Trickster variant (whether it is the original or the spell trickster version) and prepare a different version of that spell in its place. If you are interrupted during such a swap, the original spell remains prepared and can still be cast. You can try again to swap out the spell later, but you must start the process over again.

Galdr-Brewed Concotions.name: Galdr-Brewed Concotions
Galdr-Brewed Concotions.description:
You've studied the brewing of potions, an art much older and more intricate than common alchemy. By distilling magic into a potable liquid, you've unlocked new ways for you to use your learnings. You can use the Craft activity to create elixirs and potions. You immediately gain the formulas for four common 1st-level elixirs or potions. At 4th level and every 2 levels beyond that, you gain the formula for a common elixir or potion of that level or lower (a 4th-level potion if you’re 4th level, a 6th-level potion if you’re 6th level, and so on). Your spellbook doubles as your formula book.

During your daily preparations, you can create one temporary elixir or potion using a formula you know as a temporary concoction. If you have expert proficiency in spell DC, you can create a batch of two concoctions during your daily preparations, if you have master proficiency, you can create a batch of four, and if you have legendary proficiency, you can create a batch of six. Any concoctions you create this way become inert bottles of liquid the next time you make your daily preparations, and any remaining effects of the temporary items end. A temporary concoction has no value.

Hand of Judgement.name: Hand of Judgement
Hand of Judgement.description:
You place your hand on an enemy, subjecting them to your judgment. The target must attempt a Will save. The target takes 8d6 spirit damage. If the target has broken the laws of the area you are currently in within the last week they take a –2 circumstance penalty to their save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} from the weight of its guilt.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target takes double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6

Field Advantage.name: Field Advantage
Field Advantage.description: Your fluxes are not only powerful, but expanding and disruptive to the terrain. When you Cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.7exSZrsaySDHtobU]{Quasiplanar Flux}, you can choose to create difficult terrain in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] resembling the plane you chose that lasts for the duration of the spell and 2 rounds after the flux is closed.

Clone Reconstructor.name: Clone Reconstructor
Clone Reconstructor.description: Your clone has been constructed in such a way that you can reconstruct them more easily. You become trained in Medicine or an expert if you were already trained. Once per day as a 3-action activity you can attempt to reconstruct a clone that was reduced to base matter by attempting a Medicine check against a standard DC of your level by targeting the remnants of a deconstructed clone. If you are legendary in Medicine, you can use this 3-action activity once per hour instead of once per day.

Spliced-Trait Explotation.name: Spliced-Trait Explotation
Spliced-Trait Explotation.description: You can splice a trait into a spell to grant it more flexibility for exploits. For each rank you can cast, you can select one of your prepared spells during daily preparation to splice a trait into the spell slot for exploit use, allowing you to use the spell you prepared for an exploit you otherwise wouldn’t be able to use. If the exploit has other requirements based on the original spell that the spell you prepared does not fulfill, it cannot be used for that exploit.

Grand Finale.name: Grand Finale
Grand Finale.description:
You unleash an incredible spectacle of pyrotechnics, shattering objects and flashing lights to bring a fight to an end. Choose a single creature affected by the required spell, a single square within the area of the required spell, or yourself if the spell does not target creatures or an area. You end the required spell and its effect immediately, creating an explosion that deals 4d12 fire damage and 4d6 sonic damage.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} and deafened for 1 round, and then dazzled for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) Increase the fire by 1d12 and sonic damage by 1d6.

Energy Exertion.name: Energy Exertion
Energy Exertion.description:
You hurl what energy remains in your aura at a nearby enemy. You deal 1d4 damage of the same type as your residual energy, or bludgeoning damage if your residual energy has the air, earth, or water traits, piercing damage if it has the wood trait, or slashing damage if it has the metal trait. Alternatively, you can expend your residual energy to increase the damage to 2d4. This spell gains the trait of your residual energy.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4 or 2d4 if you expend your residual energy.

I Am Omnipotent!.name: I Am Omnipotent!
I Am Omnipotent!.description:
Requirements Your last action was to Cast a Spell, and you critically succeeded a spell attack roll against an enemy or a target critically failed a saving throw.

It is not uncommon for wizards of a certain strength level to forget themselves, and allow magic to briefly pull their minds into the realm of egomania. After commanding exceptionally strong magic, a wizard might be compelled to throw their head back in laughter, make grandiose statements, or gloat of superiority.

You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn. As long as you are stupefied from this effect, you can cast wizard focus spells without expending a Focus Point and without needing to roll a flat check from being stupefied. After you lose the stupefied condition from this effect, you are temporarily immune to this effect for 10 minutes.

Shadow Puppetry.name: Shadow Puppetry
Shadow Puppetry.description:
You shine light from your hand, masking it partially to create an amalgamation of shadowy creatures in the area. When you Cast the Spell, choose between acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, force, piercing, slashing, sonic, or spirit damage. You create small shadows of creatures, objects, or figments that deal 1d6 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area, and the first time you Sustain each turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Dueling Cantrips.name: Dueling Cantrips
Dueling Cantrips.description: You can wield your wand without the need to prepare with your simplest magic. When you make a spell attack roll using a cantrip, you can apply the effects of Dueling Wand and do not need to meet its requirements.

Reserved Slot Cantrip.name: Reserved Slot Cantrip
Reserved Slot Cantrip.description:
Requirements You have at least one spell slot available of the highest rank you can cast.

You know how to use spell slots on reserve to tap into additional low level magic. You can spend 10 minutes to reserve the required spell slot, losing the ability to cast the spell it contains until you Dismiss this effect. In exchange, you can cast an arcane cantrip from your spellbook as if you had it prepared while you have your spell slot reserved in this way. You can only have one reserved spell slot at a time.

Wand Adroitness.name: Wand Adroitness
Wand Adroitness.description:
Your thesis states that wands can be so much more than portable containers for a single spell. These tools allow a caster to approach a duel with the same finesse as a sword fighter, casting carefully and accurately into the core of those who oppose you. You begin play with a makeshift wand designed by you that has the arcane trait. You can create a new makeshift wand if it is ever lost or destroyed in a process that takes 1 day of downtime.

During your daily preparations, you can choose one of your wizard spell slots to place into your makeshift wand, granting your wand the chosen spell and losing the spell slot. Your makeshift wand can be overcharged, but it does not gain the broken condition and cannot be destroyed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.4QuDNcfU3ZnLGyPe]{Dueling Wand} spellshape.

Perilous Road Ahead.name: Perilous Road Ahead
Perilous Road Ahead.description:
In the face of a telling ultimatum, you see a glimpse of what is to come. The GM makes a secret [[/gmr 1d20]] roll to determine a perilous trigger. The next time the perilous trigger for the result the GM rolled occurs to a target of the spell, the GM notifies the target that the trigger has occurred. The target who triggered the effect can then choose to spend a free action to gain the listed reprieve. If the target refuses to use their free action for the effect, the GM rerolls the d20 and uses the new result for the purposes of the trigger and reprieve with the same targets as before. After a target uses their free action to gain the reprieve, the spell immediately ends for all targets and the target that used the reprieve is temporarily immune for 1 day.

In addition, you and the targets of the spell gain a +2 status bonus to initiative. You cannot recover the Focus Point you used to cast this spell until the spell ends but you can Dismiss this effect at any time.

The target would be critically hit.

6-10

The target rerolls the triggering saving throw. This is a fortune effect.
