The target would be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{knocked prone}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by a check or save.

The target immediately reduces the condition by 2 to a minimum of 0.

Aeon Étude.name: Aeon Étude
Aeon Étude.description:
In ancient cultures, aeon stones were often employed by wizards to help them explore the arcane. Your own academic path has put you in a position where you have done the same. You gain a number of additional invested item slots equal to your intelligence modifier which you can only use with aeon stones and do not count towards your limit of invested items. You gain a consumed aeon stone when you select this feat, except your consumed aeon stone also grants you the ability to cast an arcane cantrip of your choice. When you make your daily preparations, select one of your aeon stones. You can use its resonant power without adding it to a wayfinder.

Special If you have the improved familiar attunement thesis, choosing an aeon wyrd familiar requires 1 less familiar ability.

Elemental Entanglement.name: Elemental Entanglement
Elemental Entanglement.description: You have written countless papers on the properties of the elemental planes, and have found ways to siphon energy from them in such a way as to grant you total mastery over their byproducts. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.HYhmbowbprh3kpGS]{Residual Energy Capture} reaction and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.iqKLVPlvr0EebEpk]{Energy Exertion} focus cantrip in addition to your prepared cantrips.

Shared Cantrip.name: Shared Cantrip
Shared Cantrip.description:
You are adept with manipulating your cantrips. You use a 1-action spellshape and then cast a cantrip that takes 2-actions or less to cast or 3-actions or less to cast, using the same number of actions as the cantrip for this activity.

Special If you are at least a master in spell DC, the frequency is once per 10 minutes instead of once per hour.

Create Elemental.name: Create Elemental
Create Elemental.description:
Requirements You have residual energy.

You harness your residual energy and breathe life into your creation. You expend your residual energy to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as an arcane innate spell, heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level. The elemental you summon must have the same elemental trait as the residual energy you expended.

Impart Learnings.name: Impart Learnings
Impart Learnings.description:
Requirements You ended an encounter in the last hour.

After an intense encounter, you often share some of your observations with your allies—things people did right or wrong, ways magic worked unexpectedly, or even a cryptic statement about the nature of all things. You can spend 1 minute talking about the recent encounter allowing you to Aid up to 6 allies on the next exploration activity they take within the hour using Arcana for your check to Aid.

Animated Troop.name: Animated Troop
Animated Troop.description: You have learned to conduct a number of objects into an amalgamation. When you cast animated spark, you can choose to increase the size of your object to be up to Gargantuan in size provided you construct the creature from enough Bulk (subject to GM discretion). Your animated spark minions can make a melee spell attack rolls as a single action using your spell attack modifier. It can target creatures within 20 feet of it with these spell attacks and they deal the same damage as its disperse action. After the creature makes 4 of these spell attacks, the spell ends and the objects become inanimate again.

Mind and Body.name: Mind and Body
Mind and Body.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements You are in Arcane Vitalization stance.

Your mind and body are interlinked so strongly, you gain lingering energy from spells. You gain one of the following effects of your choice until the beginning of your next turn.

  • +1 status bonus to your attack rolls with force punch unarmed Strikes

  • +1 status bonus to Athletics checks

  • The circumstance bonus from your Parry with force punch increases to +2

  • +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves

Pursuit of Learning.name: Pursuit of Learning
Pursuit of Learning.description: Even as a wizard grows in power, it becomes abundantly clear to that they have only begun to scratch the surface of learning—there being no end to the pursuit. You gain two Arcana skill feats for which you meet the prerequisites and gain an additional skill increase to a skill that has the Recall Knowledge action.

School of Quasiplanar Fusionism.name: School of Quasiplanar Fusionism
School of Quasiplanar Fusionism.description:
You have learned to access the magic of other planes using minor rifts created by your magic. This class feature alters your wizard spellcasting class feature and the arcane school class feature. If you choose this class archetype, you must select Quasiplanar Fusionist Dedication as your 2nd-level class feat.

Prerequisites: You must be a wizard.

Quasiplanar Fusionist Adjustments: You do not gain the normal effects of the arcane school class feature, including additional spell slots, abilities, or spells learned from an arcane school. Your arcane school is the school of quasiplanar fusionism. You cast 1 fewer prepared spell slots from your wizard spell slots and 3 fewer cantrips. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.oqWq3F6W5HhiQVoL]{Planar Tradition} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.eWZLnEKrt1RHtQTt]{Quasiplanar Spellcasting} class features and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.7exSZrsaySDHtobU]{Quasiplanar Flux} school spell.

Fundamental Galdercraft.name: Fundamental Galdercraft
Fundamental Galdercraft.description: You have learned ways to easily switch between variant spells. When you use the Oldest Trick in the Book Activation of your grimoire, the frequency is once per round instead of once per day.

Flux Portals.name: Flux Portals
Flux Portals.description: You have advanced your ability to tear a portal between fluxes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-player-options.1WjcCWpSlkQ6AUQj]{Potent Portals} focus spell.

Dynamic Slot.name: Dynamic Slot
Dynamic Slot.description: You can enhance one of your spell slots to function as two different spells, depending on your needs. You can spend 10 minutes to choose one of your prepared spell slots to function as two spells which you could cast. You can use the spell slot to cast either spell you chose for up to 1 hour after you use the activity, after which it solidifies into one of the two spells (your choice at the time you use the activity). You can only have one spell slot prepared in this way at a time and preparing a new spell slot this way automatically causes any other dynamic spell slots to solidify into a single spell.

Linked Jabs.name: Linked Jabs
Linked Jabs.description:
Trigger You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a force punch unarmed Strike.

You have linked your force punches to the power of your school spells. You regain a focus point.

Simulacric Spellcraft.name: Simulacric Spellcraft
Simulacric Spellcraft.description:
By exploring the magic of mirrors, the art of homunculi or even deeper mysteries, you have uncovered unconventional ways to replicate life. You create a clone using your magic that mirrors your appearance in nearly every way, down to the minute details and is linked to you by magic.

Your clone functions as an eidolon, except your clone has your proficiencies, attribute modifiers, unarmed attacks, class feats, and class features. It has the Cast a Spell activity and it can cast spells as if it were you, but it shares your spell slots and focus pool when it casts spells. You share actions and Hit Points as normal for an eidolon, but it can Activate items with an Activation even if they do not have the eidolon trait, provided you could also Activate the item. Only one of you can prepare a grimoire or staff, but you can choose between you when choosing to do so. Your clone shares your saves, AC, and unarmed attack modifiers, with the exception of bonuses and penalties from circumstance and status, which apply to each of you separately. If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, your clone is deconstructed to base matter and you must spend 10 minutes to reconstruct it. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.2LSsvzMnX6ahXRFO]{Simulacrous Casting} activity.

Superior Vitalization.name: Superior Vitalization
Superior Vitalization.description: Your body becomes more resilient when bolstered by magic. You regain the temporary Hit Points from Arcane Vitalization each turn you remain in the stance.

School of Penumbral Sculpture.name: School of Penumbral Sculpture
School of Penumbral Sculpture.description:
The shape of a shadow is sculpted through obstruction and radiance, an oscillating pendulum between luminescence and obscurity. The school is said to have originated from mages who traveled the netherworld. There is said to be lessons and tomes in Shadow Absalom (in particular, the highly exclusive Guiltless Academy), but the practice is held among many of the more secretive magic schools across Golarion such as Dusk Hall in Nidal. A wizard of this school recognizes that the imagination and the unknown are made stronger by what lies in shadow.

Curriculum

  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]{Grim Tendrils}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.zdb8cjOIDVKYMWdr]{Penumbral Shroud}

  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.8cuqRFB3mWBOgy61]{Shadow Projectile}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.DeF63UTmr7rchF60]{Wall of Shadow}

Magic Map.name: Magic Map
Magic Map.description:
You conjure a scroll in your hand which maps out the surrounding area, and pinpoints the location of all creatures around you when you Cast the Spell. You create a map of the area. You can target an area you cannot see within range, but the spell cannot see through walls larger than 1 foot thick. If there is a hidden door within the location, your GM attempts a secret Perception check to determine if your map reveals the door. Each creature in the area attempts their choice of a Will save, Deception check, or Stealth check against your spell DC.

Critical Success The map erroneously marks the creature as something else, such as a shortcut through a mountain pass, a much weaker creature, or a much stronger creature.

Success The creature does not appear on the map.

Failure An illustration of the creature appears on the map in its current position and you learn its ancestry provided it's a creature you have encountered before. You and allies can attempt to Recall Knowledge on the creature as if it were present.

Critical Failure As failure, except you also learn the creature’s name and the map grants a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge on the creature.

Heightened (4th) The circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge increases to +1 on a failure and +3 on a critical failure.

Heightened (8th) The circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge increases to +2 on a failure and +4 on a critical failure.

Rudimentary Perfectionism.name: Rudimentary Perfectionism
Rudimentary Perfectionism.description:
Your writings argue that the simplest of magics are not to be underestimated, as their results can be absolutely devastating with the right application. You can prepare two additional cantrips per day.

In addition, when you Cast a heightened Spell that either deals damage or restores Hit Points, you gain a status bonus to that spell’s damage or healing equal to the number of ranks it was heightened or twice that amount if the spell was cast from a spell slot. This applies only to the initial damage or healing the spell deals when cast. An individual creature takes this damage or benefits from this healing only once per spell, even if the spell would damage or heal that creature multiple times. For instance, if you heightened a fireball to a 6th-rank spell, it would gain a +6 status bonus to damage and if you cast ignition as a 6th-rank cantrip, it would gain a +5 status bonus to damage.

Instant Surgery.name: Instant Surgery
Instant Surgery.description:
You touch a creature and, in an instant, perform a complicated medical operation which temporarily reworks their internal systems. Make a spell attack roll against the target’s AC. If you have view internal anatomy active on the creature, your spell attack roll has a +2 circumstance bonus. If the creature is willing, they can Aid you using Medicine without having to spend the preparatory action normally required to Aid.

Critical Success Select two attributes of the target and choose to boost or deplete them. All rolls made with these attributes gain a +1 or –1 status bonus or penalty, depending on your choice.

Success As critical success, but one attribute must be a +1 status boost, and one must be a –1 status penalty.

Heightened (8th) The status bonus and penalty each increase by 1.

Mage Famiiliar.name: Mage Famiiliar
Mage Famiiliar.description: Your familiar has the ability to cast potent spells. Your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.asOhEdyF8CWFbR96]{Spellcasting} familiar ability twice, but you must select two different ranks for the spells it gains.

Immortality Clause.name: Immortality Clause
Immortality Clause.description:
Cost Expend a 10th-rank spell slot

You exact the highest power you have to become invulnerable to harm.

Rebuttal r Trigger You would take damage, be slain, or subject to a harmful effect; Effect You ignore the triggering effect entirely.

Unravel 3 (manipulate) You gain 10 resistance to all damage, 20 temporary Hit Points, and regeneration 20 for 1 minute. While you have regeneration, you can't die from taking Hit Point damage and your dying condition can't increase to a value that would kill you, though if your wounded value becomes 4 or higher, you stay unconscious until your wounds are treated. If you take force or spirit damage, your regeneration deactivates until after the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.Item.OlrFDoCzswPS9qpq]{Effect: Immortality Clause}

Linked Beguiling.name: Linked Beguiling
Linked Beguiling.description:
Trigger A creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you failed a save against one of your spells or you succeeded at a spell attack roll against an off-guard creature.

You have linked your cipher to your school spells. You regain a Focus Point.

Turn The Pages.name: Turn The Pages
Turn The Pages.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements You are consulting your tome.

The pages of your spellbook flip on their own, landing on the perfect page for your situation. You choose another spell to be your Consulted Spell.

Sacred Geometry.name: Sacred Geometry
Sacred Geometry.description:
You tap into the fibers of magic through mathematical formulas best left forgotten. You use a 1-action spellshape you know and roll a [[/r 1d20]]. If your result is a 1, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, or 20, you must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC.

Critical Success You are unaffected.

Success You cannot use Sacred Geometry again for 1 minute.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, except you are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Archmage's Stronghold.name: Archmage's Stronghold
Archmage's Stronghold.description:
You have learned that home is where the heart is, but also where it’s easiest to get some much needed learning done. You gain an archmage’s stronghold, either by selecting an existing stronghold in your possession or by matter of construction through magic, placing the stronghold in an extradimensional space you can call on when you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vPWMEyVTreMOoFnm]{Planar Palace}.

You gain an additional spell slot of your highest rank which you can only use to cast planar palace to summon your archmage stronghold. Your stronghold functions identically to the spell except the servants are typically magical effects, objects, or spirits and it has access to extensive knowledge, allowing you to attempt research as if it were a library in a settlement of your level.

Flick and Point.name: Flick and Point
Flick and Point.description:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You have learned to perform tactics that help land spell attack rolls. You immediately Interact to draw your makeshift wand and can use Dueling Wand without having made a successful spell attack roll in the last round, but you must target a creature that goes after you in the initiative order in order to gain the status bonus to your spell attack roll.

Extended Cloaking.name: Extended Cloaking
Extended Cloaking.description: Staying out of sight is part of the plan. When you Cast a Spell from your wizard spell slots against an enemy @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to that enemy for a number rounds equal to the rank of the spell. You lose this concealment if you take a hostile action against that enemy.

Slot-Charged Spell.name: Slot-Charged Spell
Slot-Charged Spell.description: You boost one of your lower rank spells with the potency of another. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that is at least 3 ranks lower than the highest rank spell you can cast, you can expend one of your prepared spell slots to heighten the spell you cast by half the rank of the spell slot you chose to expend (minimum 1). The rank of the heightened spell cannot be higher than the highest rank spell you can cast.

Protective Fluxes.name: Protective Fluxes
Protective Fluxes.description: You are shrouded in protective magic whenever you have one of your fluxes active. You or allies that occupy the square of your flux gain a +1 status bonus to saves against effects that share your planar tradition. If you can cast 7th-rank spells, the status bonus increases to +2.

Multishaped Spell.name: Multishaped Spell
Multishaped Spell.description: You have created a new type of spell shape. Choose two spellshape wizard feats you have that are 1-action or less. You combine them into a new spellshape, gaining the effects of both when you Cast the Spell. If the spellshape has a cost, frequency, trigger, or requirements of any kind, you must meet the requirements of both to use your combined spellshape.

Bibliographic Goetia.name: Bibliographic Goetia
Bibliographic Goetia.description:
The wizard’s spellbook is traditionally the signature tool of your peers, but you have produced your own through esoteric study. You have a makeshift grimoire.

This grimoire acts as a regular spellbook, except that whenever you prepare a spell that has a variant from the Spell Trickster archetype, you can choose to prepare the variant or the original spell, restricting your spell slot or cantrip to the version you chose. This replaces the regular version of the spell in that particular slot. Your grimoire has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.urqvBWQpEVFI8tkU]{Oldest Trick in the Book} free action. If you prepare your spells in another grimoire, you do not gain this free action but you can still prepare variant spells as you would with your own grimoire.

Summon Jury.name: Summon Jury
Summon Jury.description:
With a wave of your hand, you call forth a jury of your foe’s peers. You summon a phantasmal jury relevant to the target creature, such as citizens of the city they are from, their colleagues or peers, or another applicable assortment of creatures suitable to judge the target. The jury occupies the space of a Huge creature.

Arrive (emotion, mental) Call to Order The target must attempt a will save as you charge them with accusation.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to its next attack roll for 1 round.

Failure The target takes a –1 status penalty to all attack rolls for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls for 1 round and to its save against the Depart effect.

Depart (emotion, mental) Verdict The jury renders a verdict on the target, and they must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to its next saving throw for 1 round.

Failure The target takes a –1 status penalty to saving throws for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is condemned for its crimes and takes a –1 status penalty to saving throws for 1 minute.

Heightened (5th) The status penalties increase to 2.

Heightened (9th) The status penalties increase to 3.

Mind Swap.name: Mind Swap
Mind Swap.description: You switch minds with your clone. You and your clone swap minds, with you becoming your clone and your clone becoming you. If you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can choose to Mind Swap as a free action with the same trigger before you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, destroying the clone after you have swapped minds. You must be able to see your clone to use this ability.

Elective School Spell.name: Elective School Spell
Elective School Spell.description: You have done some cross-studying with one of the other schools, gaining its initial school spell. Choose another school other than your own. You gain the initial school spell from that school

Quick Step Portals.name: Quick Step Portals
Quick Step Portals.description: You are more deft at stepping through your portals. When you use your Dimensional Jump exploit, you can Step after you jump through your portals. In addition, when you use the 3-action version of Dimensional Jump, you need not make Steps on solid surfaces and can treat the air as solid ground for the purposes of the Step, but if you do not end the movement from your final step on solid ground you immediately fall.

Quintessential Experimentation.name: Quintessential Experimentation
Quintessential Experimentation.description:
You have studied the very building blocks of magic closely, allowing you to find ways to break the laws of the arcane to produce brand new effects by deconstructing spell slots into raw magic and shaping them into something new. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.9Ljtc0TTqjPm5u1g]{Dimensional Jump} exploit.

Starting at 4th level, during your daily preparations, you can gain an exploit wizard feat of your choice that has a level requirement no higher than your level, which you can use until your next daily preparations.

Shine Spotlight.name: Shine Spotlight
Shine Spotlight.description:
You conjure up a powerful light that calls the attention of nearby creatures to look within. You shine a spotlight of magical nature in the area and the area must include at least one creature. Non-allied creatures within 15 feet of the burst must make a Will Save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the subjects of the spotlight and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while fascinated. If a hostile action would end the fascination, the off-guard condition remains until the hostile action is resolved. Creatures inside the spotlight are not subject to this effect.

While a creature is in the spotlight, it has a +1 status bonus to checks to Perform and a –1 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks. Creatures inside the spotlight can spend a single action to Perform to Sustain the spell on your behalf, and if the creature’s Perform result exceeds the Will DC of a creature outside the spotlight and within 15 feet of the burst, the creature becomes fascinated with the performer and off-guard for as long as it is fascinated.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-wizards.wizards-misc.Item.XGL2Vp0WNOcaJukC]{Spell Effect: Shine Spotlight}
